forest_light_shows.label: forest_light_shows
forest_light_shows.prompt: A horizontal 2D hand-drawn transparent overlay for forest scene. EXACTLY THREE very soft pale green diagonal sun beams in color #8FA87A, low opacity, narrow, in the upper half only, evenly distributed across the canvas. Plus THREE very small distant bird silhouettes (small, restrained, in the upper third, not the main subject). Plain dark teal-green background #060806 that will be made transparent. No trees, no full background, no character, no text, no UI, no other shapes. The light beams must be narrow and faint, not large opaque white areas. No geometric polygons, no abstract shapes, no scattered confetti-like dots.
forest_light_shows.notes: v2 重出: 3 根光柱 + 3 只小鸟

forest_tree_outline.label: forest_tree_outline
forest_tree_outline.prompt: A horizontal DISTANT forest treeline silhouette in 2D hand-drawn style. Trees are DENSE, naturally varying heights, filling the entire middle band of the canvas (roughly the central 35 percent of the height, NOT a sparse row). Tree silhouettes are dark greenish-black #1A2820. Above and below the treeline band, the canvas is COMPLETELY EMPTY dark void color #060806 (no patterns, no shapes, no other tree rows, no other elements). The treeline should look like a real distant forest horizon, with many overlapping tree shapes from small to medium height, dark and dense. Plain dark teal-green background #060806 that will be made transparent. No midground, no foreground, no character, no birds, no light beams, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermarks.
forest_tree_outline.notes: v3 修复（ZCode 反馈）：中段 35% 密集远山树线，覆盖率 ~30%，v2 仅 2%

forest_leaf_path.label: forest_leaf_path
forest_leaf_path.prompt: A horizontal 2D hand-drawn ground layer of dry leaves, soft earth path edge, small warm brown accents #A89060, muted green #6B8F71 leaf specks. This layer occupies ONLY THE LOWER 30 PERCENT of the canvas. The UPPER 70 PERCENT of the canvas is COMPLETELY EMPTY dark void color #060806 (no fog, no clouds, no sky details, no trees, no birds, no shapes, no patterns). The ground itself is horizontally flat (no slope). Plain dark teal-green background #060806 that will be made transparent. No character, no text, no UI, no logos.
forest_leaf_path.notes: v3 修复（ZCode 反馈）：上 70% 完全空 + 下 30% 地面

traveler_idle.label: traveler_idle
traveler_idle.prompt: A single SMALL 2D hand-drawn character sprite, side 3/4 view facing right, transparent background, occupying only the LOWER HALF of the canvas. The character should be SMALL relative to the canvas, standing in the bottom-center area, with WIDE empty space on left, right, and TOP (upper half of canvas is completely transparent / empty). Body proportions head-to-height about 1 to 3.3. Neutral adult, medium-length coat or light cloak, loose pants, simple travel boots. NO facial features drawn. Main color muted gray-green #6A7A6E, dark shadows #2A322C, very faint pale green rim light. Both feet flat on the same horizontal baseline. No scenery, no trees, no ground, no shadow on ground, no text, no UI, no logo. The character must NOT fill the canvas — leave large margins on all four sides.
traveler_idle.notes: v3 修复（ZCode 反馈）：角色占画布下半中段 30% 高度；v2 仍占 80%。模型把朝向画成朝左了——ForestShell 可用 scaleX=-1 镜像，或仍当默认角色使用。
